eyebrow: SQL Server Performance Tuning · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 12 · Index Tuning in Depth

code:
Clustered index
  IS the table — physical row order
  exactly one per table

Nonclustered index
  a separate, ordered copy of key columns
  + a pointer back to the full row
  many per table

Missing column in the NC index?
  -> Key Lookup back to the clustered index
caption: One is the table. One points at it.

code:
CREATE INDEX IX_Orders_CustomerId_OrderDate
    ON dbo.Orders (CustomerId, OrderDate);

-- Seeks: leading column
WHERE CustomerId = 4210

-- Seeks: leading + second, in order
WHERE CustomerId = 4210
  AND OrderDate >= '2026-01-01'

-- Cannot seek: trailing column alone
WHERE OrderDate >= '2026-01-01'
caption: Sorted like a phone book: last name, then first name.
